No scheduled video meetings and more time on the snow. This is a motorized specific class and we will be traveling to areas by snowmobile or snow bike. Certified American Avalanche Association class. services.name: Avalanche Rescue Course
services.desc: About “Avalanche Rescue”: Advanced rescue skills in a fast paced one day on -snow class. Duration Eight Hours Per Day Certified class by American Avalanche Association. Prerequisite for level II, but can be taken anytime, but we suggest taking after level I. For Who For recreational riders, pros, guides, and search and rescue teams.
